cases.construction: Nine fixture records above: literal ordinary operation, all four Jcc conditions, short JMP promotion, PUSH-original-return/JMP CALL, RET and unreachable NOP; compare every literal byte/physical endpoint.

cases.construction: Every original head remains byte-identical at its own source PC, including every CALL; operation is one original instruction with both frozen seeds.
cases.name: positive-direct

cases.construction: Reach an exact operation through each pinned redundant-prefix E9 spelling plus EB/relay E9; validate every edge and owner.
cases.name: positive-prefixes

notes: Pure fixtures do not satisfy whole-product structural prerequisites or native authority. Controls may be run later only by an authorized caller; no malformed candidate is executed. Both negative report statuses and assertion refusals are non-admission.
